verdict.rationale: jo supports scheduled jobs ('Give jo a job and a schedule... weekly plan, morning priorities') and passive overnight monitoring ('watch what changed, and prepare your morning'), which implies some automation, but there's no documented mechanism for users to define custom event-trigger→action rules (e.g., 'when X happens in Linear, do Y'). Missing for 10: explicit rule/trigger definition UI or API, examples of conditional event-based automations, and any documentation of a rules engine beyond scheduled briefings.
